source: Please report any adverse event after the visit.
target: 请在访视后报告任何不良事件。

source: The participant signed the informed consent form.
target: 受试者签署了知情同意书。

source: Record the study medication dose in the case report form.
target: 在病例报告表中记录研究用药剂量。

source: Vital signs were collected before dosing.
target: 给药前采集了生命体征。

source: The investigator reviewed the laboratory results.
target: 研究者审阅了实验室检查结果。

source: Please contact the study site if symptoms worsen.
target: 如果症状加重，请联系研究中心。
